hero.headline: Welcome to Crikvenica Villas
hero.subheadline: Perched on a peaceful hillside above the Adriatic Sea, just three kilometres from the beaches and lively promenade of Crikvenica, Crikvenica Villas is a unique collection of three beautifully restored stone villas on Croatia's stunning Kvarner coast.
hero.note: Surrounded by vineyards, olive groves, lavender, rosemary, and fragrant Mediterranean herbs

story.paragraph1: Perched on a peaceful hillside above the Adriatic Sea, just three kilometres from the beaches and lively promenade of Crikvenica, Crikvenica Villas is a unique collection of three beautifully restored stone villas on Croatia's stunning Kvarner coast.
story.paragraph2: Set across more than 5,000 m² of private Mediterranean grounds, the property combines the authentic charm of traditional Croatian stone houses with the comfort and privacy expected from a rural villa in Crikvenica. Surrounded by vineyards, olive groves, fig trees, flowering oleander, lavender, rosemary, and fragrant Mediterranean herbs, the estate captures the authentic spirit of Croatia's Kvarner coast while offering a peaceful retreat with breathtaking views across Kvarner Bay towards the island of Krk.
story.paragraph3: The three villas — Villa Ivanka, Villa Milka, and Villa Vesna — were lovingly restored from traditional 19th-century stone houses, preserving their original character while creating welcoming spaces for today's travellers. Each villa has its own private garden, swimming pool, and private parking, making Crikvenica Villas an ideal choice for couples seeking a romantic villa in Croatia, families looking for a private pool villa, or groups of friends wanting a memorable holiday on the Adriatic coast.
story.paragraph4: Originally restored in 2007, each house preserves the character of a traditional stara primorska kuća — the authentic stone houses of Croatia's Primorje region — while providing modern amenities, comfort, and complete privacy. Original stone walls, exposed wooden beams, and carefully selected furnishings reflect the heritage of the region, while contemporary facilities ensure a relaxing stay in every season.
story.paragraph5: Although the villas offer complete peace and privacy, the seaside town of Crikvenica is only a short drive away. Guests will find everything needed for a memorable holiday: local shops, a wide choice of restaurants, cafés, bars, ice cream parlours, beautiful beaches, and activities both on the water and on land. The nearby island of Krk, coastal villages, walking trails, and scenic viewpoints make the area an ideal destination for exploring the beauty of the Kvarner region.
story.paragraph6: Whether you are planning a romantic escape, a family holiday, or a gathering with friends, Crikvenica Villas offers an authentic Croatian villa experience where heritage, nature, privacy, and contemporary comfort come together.

location.title: Crikvenica, Croatia
location.text: Set on Croatia's Kvarner coast, surrounded by sea, hills, and Mediterranean greenery.

ivanka.short: One Bedroom. One Pool. No One Else.
ivanka.long:
Perched on a hillside above the seaside town of Crikvenica, Villa Ivanka enjoys breathtaking views across Kvarner Bay and the island of Krk. Far from the crowds yet only minutes from the coast, this lovingly restored stone house is a peaceful retreat for couples seeking romance, privacy, and a touch of adventure.

Villa Ivanka is part of Crikvenica Villas — Three Stone Villas, a family-owned property spanning more than 5,000 m². Surrounded by vineyards, olive groves, fig trees, flowering oleander, lavender, and fragrant Mediterranean herbs, it captures the authentic spirit of Croatia's Kvarner coast while offering every modern comfort.

Originally built in 1895, Villa Ivanka was carefully restored in 2007, preserving its thick stone walls, exposed wooden beams, and the timeless character of a traditional stara primorska kuća. Antique furnishings complement the historic architecture, while modern amenities ensure a comfortable and relaxing stay.

Outside, your private Mediterranean garden offers complete tranquillity. The unique circular swimming pool, sun loungers, and covered terrace with a barbecue create the perfect setting for long summer days and unforgettable evenings overlooking the Adriatic Sea. A small herb garden with rosemary, lavender, basil, and parsley is available for guests to enjoy.

The ground floor features a welcoming living room, a fully equipped open-plan kitchen and dining area, and a bathroom with a walk-in shower. A wooden staircase leads to the first-floor bedroom and a second bathroom. The air-conditioned bedroom, with its original stone walls, opens onto the upper Mediterranean garden and offers spectacular panoramic views across Selce, the island of Krk, and the sparkling Adriatic Sea.

Whether enjoying breakfast on the terrace, an afternoon by the pool, or watching the sunset over the sea, Villa Ivanka offers a truly private escape where heritage, nature, and contemporary comfort come together.

milka.long:
Surrounded by stone walls and Mediterranean gardens, Villa Milka is a welcoming family retreat where guests can slow down, reconnect, and enjoy the space and privacy of the countryside. With beautiful views across Kvarner Bay and the island of Krk, it offers the perfect balance of peaceful surroundings and easy access to the Adriatic coast.

The villa combines the authentic character of a traditional stara primorska kuća with modern comfort. Original stone walls, exposed timber beams, and carefully chosen antique furnishings create a warm, homely atmosphere, while central heating and air conditioning provide year-round comfort.

The spacious enclosed garden is designed with families in mind. Children have plenty of room to play safely, with a playground providing even more outdoor fun, while adults can unwind beside the private 6 × 4 metre swimming pool. A covered terrace with a traditional barbecue, long wooden dining table, sun loungers, and an outdoor shower provides the perfect setting for leisurely afternoons and long summer evenings overlooking the olive grove.

The villa comfortably accommodates four to six guests across two floors and a converted loft.

The entrance level features a cosy living room with a comfortable sofa, offering a relaxing place to unwind after a day by the sea. A separate, fully equipped kitchen with a dining area is perfect for leisurely breakfasts and family meals, while a guest WC is conveniently tucked beneath the staircase.

A wooden staircase leads to the first floor, where two double bedrooms enjoy beautiful sea views. One features a romantic freestanding bathtub beside the window, while the other has an en-suite shower room.

The converted loft offers a third bedroom with twin beds, along with its own shower room and separate WC, making it an excellent choice for older children, teenagers, or another couple.

Fragrant rosemary, lavender, olive trees, fig trees, oleander, and other native Mediterranean plants frame the property, completing the authentic atmosphere of Croatia's Kvarner coast.

vesna.short: Where Family and Friends Come Together
vesna.long:
Set on a peaceful hillside above Crikvenica, Villa Vesna is a beautifully restored stone retreat designed for families and groups of friends who want to spend time together without giving up their own privacy. Arranged across several levels, it combines character, comfort, and spectacular views over Kvarner Bay and the island of Krk.

The house preserves the authentic charm of a traditional stara primorska kuća while offering every modern convenience. Original stone walls, exposed wooden beams, colourful fabrics, and carefully selected artwork create interiors that are warm, inviting, and effortlessly elegant.

The property accommodates up to eight guests in four air-conditioned double bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bathroom and beautiful Adriatic views. Two bedrooms are located on the ground floor, with two more on the upper level, giving everyone their own private retreat while maintaining a layout that is ideal for shared holidays.

Halfway between the two bedroom levels, a charming traditional dining room centred around an original open fireplace forms the heart of the house, creating the perfect setting for leisurely meals and relaxed evenings. The fully equipped kitchen opens directly onto a spacious covered terrace with a traditional barbecue, where long summer lunches and dinners naturally extend into unforgettable evenings beneath the stars.

One of the property's hidden gems is the original wine cellar, now transformed into a cosy lounge and TV room. Naturally cool even in summer, it offers a welcome escape during the warmest part of the day.

Outside, Mediterranean gardens frame a private 8 × 4.5 metre swimming pool with an outdoor shower, sun loungers, and a shaded terrace overlooking the Adriatic. Fragrant lavender, rosemary, olive trees, fig trees, flowering oleander, and other native Mediterranean plants complete the authentic atmosphere of this unique stone retreat on Croatia's Kvarner coast.
